title: Kamailio At RTC Conference 2022
html:
Fred Posner will present about Kamailio at RTC Conference 2022, the event organized by Ilinois Institute of Technology, this year taking place online.

The presentation “Kamailio: 20 years of Open Source SIP” is scheduled at 09:30 US Central Time on Tuesday, October 11, 2022, in the WebRTC and “Real-Time Applications” track.

More details about the event and schedule can be found at:

  • https://www.rtc-conference.com

Thanks for flying Kamailio!
